implementation.targetScope: ProseMirror model 1.25.12 schemas, persistent documents, marks, positions, slices, replacement, content matching and DOM parsing/serialization. Tiptap 2.11.7 application extension and command fixtures; upstream 1.25.12 and app 1.25.4 controls. Editor browser/IME/clipboard deployment acceptance is separate.

changes: Independent boundary-token replacement preserves untouched subtrees and persistent document history.
Own-key schema attributes and null-prototype records ignore inherited attribute input.
Reject fractional/out-of-range resolved positions and negative/fractional serialized slice depths.
Map DOM source offsets through whitespace normalization and trailing trim, avoiding misplaced or negative cursor positions.
Content-expression NFA/DFA and breadth-first wrapping/filling; bounded repeat counts.
DOM construction uses document APIs, preserves attribute-array injection protection, and shares active mark wrappers.
One VPM runtime dependency: vorderedmap 2.1.1. No upstream runtime files shipped.
